title: DSH · Cost
description: What the agent spent, and on what. Rates are dashboard variables per million tokens, in the currency picked above; the defaults are DeepSeek's published deepseek-v4-flash peak rates in CNY. Switching currency changes the symbol, not the rates — retype those too. One rate set applies to every selected model, so pick a single model when you run several at different prices.

list.name: model
list.label: Model
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT `span_attributes.gen_ai.request.model` FROM opentelemetry_traces WHERE `span_attributes.gen_ai.request.model` IS NOT NULL

list.name: currency
list.label: Currency
list.description: Only the symbol the numbers are formatted with. The rates below are read in whatever currency you type them in.

list.name: price_in
list.label: Input /1M
list.description: Uncached input, what the provider calls a cache miss. DeepSeek deepseek-v4-flash peak: 3.0 CNY, 0.44 USD.

list.name: price_cache_read
list.label: Cache read /1M
list.description: Input served from the provider’s cache. DeepSeek deepseek-v4-flash peak: 0.10 CNY, 0.014 USD.

list.name: price_cache_write
list.label: Cache write /1M
list.description: DSH counts cache writes separately from input. DeepSeek publishes no write premium, so this defaults to the input rate; providers that charge one (Anthropic) want a higher number here.

list.name: price_out
list.label: Output /1M
list.description: Reasoning tokens are already part of the output count, and are billed as output. DeepSeek deepseek-v4-flash peak: 9.0 CNY, 1.32 USD.

panels.title: Estimated spend
panels.description: Token counts from the model calls, priced with the rates above. An estimate: it knows nothing about your contract, promotions, or a provider's time-of-day discount.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND((SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.dsh.usage.uncached_input_tokens`, 0)) * $price_in + SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.dsh.usage.cache_read_tokens`, 0)) * $price_cache_read + SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.dsh.usage.cache_write_tokens`, 0)) * $price_cache_write + SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.gen_ai.usage.output_tokens`, 0)) * $price_out) / 1000000.0, 4) AS spend FROM opentelemetry_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND `span_attributes.gen_ai.system` IS NOT NULL AND `span_attributes.dsh.session.id` IS NOT NULL AND `span_attributes.gen_ai.request.model` IN ($model)
SELECT '$currency' AS unit

panels.title: Per turn
panels.description: Spend divided by the turns that reached the model. This is the number to watch when you change a prompt, a tool set, or a compaction policy.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND((SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.dsh.usage.uncached_input_tokens`, 0)) * $price_in + SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.dsh.usage.cache_read_tokens`, 0)) * $price_cache_read + SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.dsh.usage.cache_write_tokens`, 0)) * $price_cache_write + SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.gen_ai.usage.output_tokens`, 0)) * $price_out) / 1000000.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT trace_id), 0), 4) AS spend FROM opentelemetry_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND `span_attributes.gen_ai.system` IS NOT NULL AND `span_attributes.dsh.session.id` IS NOT NULL AND `span_attributes.gen_ai.request.model` IN ($model)
SELECT '$currency' AS unit

panels.title: Per session
panels.description: Spend divided by the sessions seen in this window. A session is one DSH conversation, however many turns it took.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND((SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.dsh.usage.uncached_input_tokens`, 0)) * $price_in + SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.dsh.usage.cache_read_tokens`, 0)) * $price_cache_read + SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.dsh.usage.cache_write_tokens`, 0)) * $price_cache_write + SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.gen_ai.usage.output_tokens`, 0)) * $price_out) / 1000000.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT `span_attributes.dsh.session.id`), 0), 4) AS spend FROM opentelemetry_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND `span_attributes.gen_ai.system` IS NOT NULL AND `span_attributes.dsh.session.id` IS NOT NULL AND `span_attributes.gen_ai.request.model` IN ($model)
SELECT '$currency' AS unit

panels.title: Saved by cache
panels.description: What the cached input would have cost at the miss rate, minus what it did cost and what the provider charged to write the cache.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND((SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.dsh.usage.cache_read_tokens`, 0)) * ($price_in - $price_cache_read) + SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.dsh.usage.cache_write_tokens`, 0)) * ($price_in - $price_cache_write)) / 1000000.0, 4) AS spend FROM opentelemetry_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND `span_attributes.gen_ai.system` IS NOT NULL AND `span_attributes.dsh.session.id` IS NOT NULL AND `span_attributes.gen_ai.request.model` IN ($model)
SELECT '$currency' AS unit

SELECT date_bin('5 minutes'::INTERVAL, timestamp) AS time, `span_attributes.gen_ai.request.model` AS model, ROUND((SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.dsh.usage.uncached_input_tokens`, 0)) * $price_in + SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.dsh.usage.cache_read_tokens`, 0)) * $price_cache_read + SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.dsh.usage.cache_write_tokens`, 0)) * $price_cache_write + SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.gen_ai.usage.output_tokens`, 0)) * $price_out) / 1000000.0, 6) AS spend FROM opentelemetry_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND `span_attributes.gen_ai.system` IS NOT NULL AND `span_attributes.dsh.session.id` IS NOT NULL AND `span_attributes.gen_ai.request.model` IN ($model) GROUP BY time, model ORDER BY time
SELECT '$currency' AS unit

panels.title: Spend by token class
panels.description: The four things you pay for. Output usually dominates until context grows; then uncached input takes over.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.dsh.usage.uncached_input_tokens`, 0)) * $price_in / 1000000.0, 4) AS uncached_input, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.dsh.usage.cache_read_tokens`, 0)) * $price_cache_read / 1000000.0, 4) AS cache_read, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.dsh.usage.cache_write_tokens`, 0)) * $price_cache_write / 1000000.0, 4) AS cache_write, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.gen_ai.usage.output_tokens`, 0)) * $price_out / 1000000.0, 4) AS output FROM opentelemetry_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND `span_attributes.gen_ai.system` IS NOT NULL AND `span_attributes.dsh.session.id` IS NOT NULL AND `span_attributes.gen_ai.request.model` IN ($model)
SELECT '$currency' AS unit

SELECT `span_attributes.gen_ai.request.model` AS model, COUNT(*) AS calls, ROUND((SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.dsh.usage.uncached_input_tokens`, 0)) * $price_in + SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.dsh.usage.cache_read_tokens`, 0)) * $price_cache_read + SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.dsh.usage.cache_write_tokens`, 0)) * $price_cache_write + SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.gen_ai.usage.output_tokens`, 0)) * $price_out) / 1000000.0, 4) AS spend, ROUND((SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.dsh.usage.uncached_input_tokens`, 0)) * $price_in + SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.dsh.usage.cache_read_tokens`, 0)) * $price_cache_read + SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.dsh.usage.cache_write_tokens`, 0)) * $price_cache_write + SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.gen_ai.usage.output_tokens`, 0)) * $price_out) / 1000000.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 6) AS spend_per_call FROM opentelemetry_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND `span_attributes.gen_ai.system` IS NOT NULL AND `span_attributes.dsh.session.id` IS NOT NULL AND `span_attributes.gen_ai.request.model` IN ($model) GROUP BY model ORDER BY spend DESC
SELECT '$currency' AS unit

panels.title: Spend by hour of day (UTC)
panels.description: Where the agent's hours fall. Actionable when the provider prices by time of day, as DeepSeek's off-peak discount does.

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat(lpad(CAST(CAST(date_part('hour', timestamp) AS BIGINT) AS STRING), 2, '0'), ':00') AS hour_utc, ROUND((SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.dsh.usage.uncached_input_tokens`, 0)) * $price_in + SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.dsh.usage.cache_read_tokens`, 0)) * $price_cache_read + SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.dsh.usage.cache_write_tokens`, 0)) * $price_cache_write + SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.gen_ai.usage.output_tokens`, 0)) * $price_out) / 1000000.0, 4) AS spend FROM opentelemetry_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND `span_attributes.gen_ai.system` IS NOT NULL AND `span_attributes.dsh.session.id` IS NOT NULL AND `span_attributes.gen_ai.request.model` IN ($model) GROUP BY hour_utc ORDER BY hour_utc
SELECT '$currency' AS unit

panels.title: Most expensive sessions
panels.description: Click a session to open its turns in the trace explorer or its events in the log explorer.

value.title: Open this session in the trace explorer
See this session in the log explorer

targets.rawSql: SELECT `span_attributes.dsh.session.id` AS session, COUNT(DISTINCT trace_id) AS turns, COUNT(*) AS calls, ROUND((SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.dsh.usage.uncached_input_tokens`, 0)) * $price_in + SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.dsh.usage.cache_read_tokens`, 0)) * $price_cache_read + SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.dsh.usage.cache_write_tokens`, 0)) * $price_cache_write + SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.gen_ai.usage.output_tokens`, 0)) * $price_out) / 1000000.0, 4) AS spend, ROUND((SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.dsh.usage.uncached_input_tokens`, 0)) * $price_in + SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.dsh.usage.cache_read_tokens`, 0)) * $price_cache_read + SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.dsh.usage.cache_write_tokens`, 0)) * $price_cache_write + SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.gen_ai.usage.output_tokens`, 0)) * $price_out) / 1000000.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT trace_id), 0), 4) AS spend_per_turn FROM opentelemetry_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND `span_attributes.gen_ai.system` IS NOT NULL AND `span_attributes.dsh.session.id` IS NOT NULL AND `span_attributes.gen_ai.request.model` IN ($model) GROUP BY session ORDER BY spend DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT '$currency' AS unit

panels.title: Spend by turn outcome
panels.description: What the turns you paid for ended up doing. `unfinished` is a turn whose end event never arrived. Spend is attributed per model call, so a turn that switched models splits across them.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(reason, 'unfinished') AS reason, ROUND(SUM(spend), 4) AS spend FROM (SELECT model, MAX(reason) OVER (PARTITION BY trace_id) AS reason, spend FROM (SELECT trace_id, `span_attributes.gen_ai.request.model` AS model, MAX(CASE WHEN span_name = 'invoke_agent dsh' THEN `span_attributes.dsh.turn.end_reason` END) AS reason, (SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.dsh.usage.uncached_input_tokens`, 0)) * $price_in + SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.dsh.usage.cache_read_tokens`, 0)) * $price_cache_read + SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.dsh.usage.cache_write_tokens`, 0)) * $price_cache_write + SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.gen_ai.usage.output_tokens`, 0)) * $price_out) / 1000000.0 AS spend FROM opentelemetry_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND `span_attributes.dsh.session.id` IS NOT NULL GROUP BY trace_id, model)) WHERE model IN ($model) GROUP BY reason ORDER BY spend DESC
SELECT '$currency' AS unit

panels.title: Billed input tokens by step
panels.description: Position of the model call inside its turn, ranked by start time rather than read from dsh.step, so it holds whatever numbering the harness uses. Every step resends the conversation so far; this is the shape of that growth.

targets.rawSql: SELECT lpad(CAST(step AS STRING), 2, '0') AS step, mean, p95 FROM (SELECT step, ROUND(AVG(input), 0) AS mean, ROUND(approx_percentile_cont(input, 0.95), 0) AS p95 FROM (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY trace_id ORDER BY timestamp) AS step, COALESCE(`span_attributes.gen_ai.usage.input_tokens`, 0) AS input FROM opentelemetry_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND `span_attributes.gen_ai.system` IS NOT NULL AND `span_attributes.dsh.session.id` IS NOT NULL AND `span_attributes.gen_ai.request.model` IN ($model)) GROUP BY step) ORDER BY step

panels.title: Billed input tokens by turn
panels.description: The same growth across a session rather than within a turn: turn 20 carries everything turns 1 to 19 said. Turns are ranked within their session, so the axis reads the same whatever numbering the harness uses. When this climbs, compaction or a fresh session is the cheaper move.

targets.rawSql: SELECT lpad(CAST(turn AS STRING), 3, '0') AS turn, mean, p95 FROM (SELECT turn, ROUND(AVG(input), 0) AS mean, ROUND(approx_percentile_cont(input, 0.95), 0) AS p95 FROM (SELECT DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY turn_id) AS turn, input FROM (SELECT `span_attributes.dsh.session.id` AS session, `span_attributes.dsh.turn` AS turn_id, COALESCE(`span_attributes.gen_ai.usage.input_tokens`, 0) AS input FROM opentelemetry_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND `span_attributes.gen_ai.system` IS NOT NULL AND `span_attributes.dsh.session.id` IS NOT NULL AND `span_attributes.gen_ai.request.model` IN ($model) AND `span_attributes.dsh.turn` IS NOT NULL)) GROUP BY turn) ORDER BY turn

panels.title: Spend per turn over time
panels.description: The trend that says whether a change made the agent cheaper. Flat here with rising total spend means you are simply running more.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_bin('15 minutes'::INTERVAL, timestamp) AS time, ROUND((SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.dsh.usage.uncached_input_tokens`, 0)) * $price_in + SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.dsh.usage.cache_read_tokens`, 0)) * $price_cache_read + SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.dsh.usage.cache_write_tokens`, 0)) * $price_cache_write + SUM(COALESCE(`span_attributes.gen_ai.usage.output_tokens`, 0)) * $price_out) / 1000000.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT trace_id), 0), 6) AS spend_per_turn FROM opentelemetry_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND `span_attributes.gen_ai.system` IS NOT NULL AND `span_attributes.dsh.session.id` IS NOT NULL AND `span_attributes.gen_ai.request.model` IN ($model) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
SELECT '$currency' AS unit
